policy: Disclosed ordinary-command policy: three of every four eligible adult work years pursue the target path (age % 4 !== 3); Auto-mode safe choices; surplus grain sold after reserving next-year seed and household rations; missing skills practiced first; apprentice fallback when cash/materials block work; military appointments sought when required; zero state or cash injection.

wealthDefinitions.low-wealth: Starts born into delta-newcomers (initial cash 20-80 dr, initial net worth 207-417 dr).
wealthDefinitions.ordinary: All other household starting origins (tenant-farming, soldier, artisan, estate, and royal households).

balanceTarget.note: Authored design target for birth-cohort completion to depth 10; measured rates describe simulation behavior under the disclosed policy, not guaranteed player outcomes.
